description: This file defines a specialized vector class for double-precision floating point numbers using AVX2 intrinsics, including various vector operations, load/store functions, and mathematical functions.

classes.name: Vectorized<double>
classes.description: A SIMD vector class for double-precision floating point numbers using AVX2 intrinsics, supporting various vector operations, mathematical functions, and comparisons.

methods.name: maximum
methods.description: Returns element-wise maximum of two Vectorized<double> instances, propagating NaNs.

methods.name: minimum
methods.description: Returns element-wise minimum of two Vectorized<double> instances, propagating NaNs.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps the values of a Vectorized<double> between min and max.

methods.name: clamp_min
methods.description: Clamps the values of a Vectorized<double> to be at least min.

methods.name: clamp_max
methods.description: Clamps the values of a Vectorized<double> to be at most max.
